purpose: Teach: 神経質/奪い/無駄遣い/辛口/刃物/利い/ろくに/使い道

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、神経質に、ならないでね、メイ姉さん、いつでも、相談、乗ってあげるからね、約束、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Sho, don't worry, okay? Mei-sis is here anytime you need to talk. I promise. I mean it.
lines.style: Warm and reassuring, speaking down to a child with genuine tenderness. Soft opening. Slow, deliberate pacing. Breath under the words. A small pause before the promise, making it feel solid.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達、玩具、奪い、しないでね、メイ姉さん、約束したから、ぼく、絶対、優しくするね、本当に。
lines.en: I won't take my friends' toys without asking, Mei-sis. I promised, so I'll be really gentle. For real.
lines.style: Quiet determination. The careful enunciation of a child making a serious vow to someone he trusts. Slight tremor of earnestness. Meets her eyes with the solemnity of a secret pact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、無駄遣い、ちょっと、しちゃう癖、あるのよ、本気で、直したいんだ、本当に、絶対、頑張る、ね。
lines.en: You know, I have this habit of spending money without thinking. I really want to stop. I'm going to try harder. I promise.
lines.style: Gentle self-critique, like she's confessing something small but true. Slight hesitation before admitting the weakness. Soft determination on the resolve. Not seeking pity, just honesty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、辛口の食事、本気で、好きなんだよね、メイ姉さん、ぼくも、いつか、食べられるかな、本気で。
lines.en: Dad really loves spicy food, you know? Mei-sis, do you think I'll be able to eat it someday too? Really?
lines.style: Curious and hopeful, the wondering of a child looking up at his older sister. Open-ended lilt on the question. A little wistfulness underneath—wanting to be like his father. Unguarded wonder.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お料理の時、刃物、本気で、注意して、使ってね、翔くん、メイ姉さん、心配だからね、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: When you're cooking, please be really careful with the knives, okay Sho? Mei-sis worries about you. Promise me.
lines.style: Shift to concern, protective but not alarming. Warm firmness. The voice of someone who's seen accidents. Measured delivery, grounded. Genuine worry underneath, held steady for the child's sake.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんが、本気で、利いた言葉、ぼく、絶対、覚えてるよ、心に、響いたんだ、本当に、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: The things you said really stuck with me, Mei-sis. I'll never forget them. They touched my heart. I'm really grateful.
lines.style: Soft, grateful reverence. The voice of a child who has been truly seen by an adult he loves. Slower pace. Each phrase carries weight. Slight break before gratitude—genuine overflow of feeling, not performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、ろくに、翔くんと、会えてなかったわよね、メイ姉さん、本気で、寂しかったよ、また、絶対、会おうね、約束。
lines.en: I haven't been able to see you much lately, have I? Mei-sis really missed you. Let's make sure we see each other again soon, okay? Promise?
lines.style: Wistful and gentle. Opening with a quiet realization—the sadness of distance. Slight catch in her voice. Warm recovery as she pivots to hope. Lingering softly on the promise, almost a question, inviting him into the agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お年玉の使い道、メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、相談したいよ、お願い、絶対、聞いてくれる?本当に、ありがとう。
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to talk to you about how to spend my New Year's money. Will you help me think about it? Please? Thank you.
lines.style: Eager and trusting. Child's directness mixed with politeness. Slight rush of excitement at the prospect of her guidance. The gratitude at the end feels premature, genuine—already certain she'll say yes.
